jamband.title: Jam band
jamband.intro: The jams you have saved, and the ones that come with the skill. Play one on the device, give it another name, take it to another program as a MIDI file, or delete it.
jamband.mine.title: Your jams
jamband.skill.title: Jams that come with the skill
jamband.ask: Say "let's jam" to start a new one, or "surprise me" for one Emkay makes up.
jamband.sure: Delete this jam from the device?
jamband.none: No saved jams yet. At the end of a jam, say yes when asked to save it.
